reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #518 '[每日信息流] 2024-07-12' is not an engineering request. It is an auto-generated daily security-news digest (label 'daily'), produced by .github/workflows/daily.yml via `gh issue create --title "[每日信息流] `date +'%Y-%m-%d'`" -F today.md --label "daily"`. Its 43262-char body is a flat list of external news links (Der Flounder, Recent Commits to cve:main, Security Boulevard, Twitter @Nicolas Krassas, Packet Storm, Red Hat/RHSA advisories, etc.) for 2024-07-11/12. It contains (a) no reproducible defect, (b) no feature request, (c) no component/file reference, and (d) no code-change instruction. Repository state confirms this is a content artifact: no AGENTS.md, no package.json/test suite (Python RSS-aggregator: bot.py, yarb.py; _config.yml; requirements.txt), and the repo already auto-generates one such issue per day (labels 'daily'/'dailypick'). The extracted '$151K / 151000 USD' funding is spurious: it is scraped from a digest headline in the issue body, 'Google increases bug bounty rewards five times, up to $151K', not a real bounty on this repo. Prior failures: none. No competing PR: the only open PR is unrelated (#1361, fix-issue-1360). Per the delivery-supervisor rule, a bot-generated content/digest deliverable with no repository code change must be classified blocked rather than converted into a fallback PR; checkout left unchanged.
